title: Cordyceps@LT-EDI: Patching Language-Specific Homophobia/Transphobia Classifiers with a Multilingual Understanding
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical task of detecting homophobic and transphobic hate speech in social media comments across different languages. While the subject matter is related to social harm and ethical application, the paper's core research does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics as academic or philosophical domains.
